label: NATIONS LEAGUE · MADRID
headline: England end Spain's 43-game unbeaten run
sub: Kane (pen), Konsa and White made it 3–0. Anderson was sent off, Oyarzabal and Nico Williams pulled two back, and 10-man England held on.
caption:
🦁 Spain 2–3 England.

Harry Kane, Ezri Konsa and Ben White put England 3–0 up in Madrid. Elliot Anderson was sent off, Spain scored twice, but Thomas Tuchel's 10 men held on to end Spain's 43-game unbeaten run and win the group.

England's best win under Tuchel? 👇

label: NATIONS LEAGUE · BRUSSELS
headline: Belgium thrash Italy and go through
sub: Pio Esposito scored first, then De Cuyper, Ngoy, Doku and Moreira hit back. Italy finish third and are out of the quarter-finals.
caption:
🇧🇪 Belgium 4–1 Italy.

Francesco Pio Esposito put Italy ahead, but Maxim De Cuyper, Nathan Ngoy, Jérémy Doku and Diego Moreira turned it around. Belgium reach the Nations League quarter-finals and Italy go out.

label: NATIONS LEAGUE · BORDEAUX
headline: Zidane's France top the group
sub: An own goal and Junior Kroupi's first France goal did it. Bardakçı's late header was only a consolation.
caption:
🇫🇷 France 2–1 Türkiye.

An Emirhan Topçu own goal and Junior Kroupi's first international goal sent Zinedine Zidane's France into the Nations League quarter-finals as group winners. Abdülkerim Bardakçı headed in late for Türkiye.
